Method

06 · the gate — what is measured and what is merely built

The headline, stated plainly

this is the most important sentence on the site

No skill number on this site has been measured. There is no backtest, the lambda beta is asserted rather than fitted, and the forecast intervals are uncalibrated. This is not an oversight to be filled in later — for two of the three it is unobtainable with the data available, and saying so is more useful than a number nobody should trust.

Why the backtest cannot run

the honest version

Scoring our own estimate against past actuals is possible — the filings carry them. Scoring it against the Street's bar as it stood at those quarters is not: no source available to this build publishes consensus history. Without that, skill against consensus, the lambda regression and the per-regime beta table are all unobtainable rather than merely unmeasured. The market adapter that could serve current consensus was written, tested, and then deliberately refused to answer a historical as-of date, because returning today's estimates for a past quarter is lookahead that shows up as skill.

Why the intervals are uncalibrated

and what that means for reading them

Calibration answers one question: of the times we said p10 to p90, how often did reality land inside? Answering it needs stored residuals from previous runs, and there are none — this is the first. So the bands on the Forecast sheet are the judge's own opinion of its uncertainty, and have never been checked against an outcome. Without that check a distribution is decorative, which is exactly why it is labelled instead of charted against a diagonal that would imply it had been tested.

The ablation that would decide which lenses earn their tokens

not run — and this is the only acceptable basis for dropping a lens

Leave one lens out, re-run the judge against cached lens outputs, and record the change in error. A lens whose removal does not degrade the score is droppable on evidence. It costs one deep call per lens and needs an error to measure against — which loops back to the backtest. Until it runs, the nine-lens roster is a design claim rather than a measured one, and the two lenses that abstained most often on this run are the obvious first candidates.
